dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interlocking irregular 'O' and 'C' shapes with high-contrast light-grey perimeters transitioning to dark-grey interiors, concentrated on the mid-lateral and dorsal surfaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters interspersed between lighter annular regions, particularly along the mid-body axis.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Triangular spatial relationship formed by the centroids of three prominent light-ring structures on the upper lateral flank, and a linear alignment of four small dark blobs on the lower lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct linear dark depression located on the mid-lateral surface, appearing as a deep cutaneous fold or healed traumatic mark.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent upper-right anatomical structure exhibiting five distinct, dark, parallel high-contrast linear marks corresponding to claw-like features.
